description: This PHP class implements a decorator for the EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and format various attributes of immigration records, such as issue date, expiry date, review date, country name, and document type, often wrapping underlying entity methods with additional logic like date formatting and country name retrieval via services.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeImmigrationRecord providing formatted access to immigration record attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeImmigrationRecord instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity related to the immigration record based on employee number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted issued date of the immigration record.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted expiry date of the immigration record.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted review date of the immigration record.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves the country name based on the country code in the immigration record.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the document type string based on the record's type.
